gloss: year before an unlucky year; pre-calamity year

definitions.gloss: year before an unlucky year; pre-calamity year
definitions.explanation: The year immediately preceding the main unlucky year (本厄) in the yakudoshi cycle. Considered a warning period when one should begin exercising caution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前厄|まえやく}だ。
examples.english: Next year is my pre-calamity year.

examples.japanese: {前厄|まえやく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since it's my pre-calamity year, I had a purification performed at the shrine.

examples.japanese: {前厄|まえやく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ{始|はじ}める⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}け→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧たり⟦{厄除|やくよ}け→厄除け：24744_yakuyoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many people start being careful from the pre-calamity year, avoiding major decisions and carrying protective charms.

notes:
Part of the ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ (unlucky year) cycle in Japanese folk belief. The three-year cycle consists of {前厄|まえやく} → ⟦{本厄|ほんやく}→本厄：25008_honyaku⟧ (main unlucky year) → ⟦{後厄|あとやく}→後厄：25749_atoyaku⟧ (year after). {前厄|まえやく} is the lead-in period, and many people already begin visiting shrines for ⟦{厄払|やくばら}い→厄払い：22342_yakubarai⟧ (purification) during this year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前厄|まえやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the pre-calamity year
- {前厄|まえやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧: purification for the pre-calamity year
- {前厄|まえやく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧: to start being careful from the pre-calamity year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本厄|ほんやく}→本厄：25008_honyaku⟧: main unlucky year — the central and most critical year in the cycle
- ⟦{後厄|あとやく}→後厄：25749_atoyaku⟧: year after the unlucky year — the final year of the cycle, when misfortune is thought to be fading
- ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧: unlucky year — the general term for the entire system
- ⟦{厄払|やくばら}い→厄払い：22342_yakubarai⟧: purification ritual — the ceremony performed to ward off bad luck
